title: Can ChatGPT Make Explanatory Inferences? Benchmarks for Abductive Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The model's ability to generate a novel religious entity (a deity) as a creative explanatory hypothesis.
findings: The model (ChatGPT 4) successfully and originally generated a novel deity ('Thermara, goddess of elemental balance') as a creative explanatory hypothesis for global warming. This demonstrates its capacity for creative generation of religious/mythological concepts.
